algorithm: Independent OpenCV connectedComponents 8-connectivity; numpy per-label maximum and minimum row-major index; SciPy sparse maximum bipartite matching. Original scoring/matching/summary functions not imported.

source_review.threshold_semantics: analysis/analyze.py components labels probability >= threshold with 8 connectivity. No special zero-prediction case at threshold1.
source_review.peak_ties: Maximum probability per component, ties first row-major pixel, center coordinate +0.5; original bbox half-open. Independent implementation replicated this rule.
source_review.matching: Original deterministic augmenting-path matching is maximum-cardinality. Independent SciPy sparse maximum bipartite matching exactly reproduces all total and strict-small frame counts. Assignment identities among overlapping boxes are not used to establish calibration counts.
source_review.fusion: infer_with_windows.py tiled_logits returns CPU FP32 logits; infer_pilot.py calls CPU sigmoid, then only five starts [0,36,72,108,120] enter probability maximum fusion. All10 fused NPZ maps independently rebuilt bit-exactly.
source_review.calibration: All calibration frames equal320; integer budget inequality reduces to U<=4015. All23 frozen thresholds checked, no threshold added or selected post hoc.
source_review.annotation_alignment: All320 original JPEGs matched raw NPY pixels exactly; source image IDs, filenames, numeric frame order0..159, annotation-ID sets, scorer object records and NPZ offsets agreed. Human visibility/completeness was not independently established.

interpretation.threshold1_explanation: Saved FP32 sigmoid probabilities contain exact1 values. With >=1 these pixels remain, produce genuine 8-connected components, and unmatched count is components minus maximum one-to-one matches. Finite-precision saturation is empirically demonstrated, not literal certainty or an infinite-logit claim.
interpretation.failure_scope: Current four512-step weak-box adaptations, one seed46, common frozen-BN/new-Adam setup and two selected calibration clips fail the predefined23-point diagnostic component budget. No claim about all possible thresholds, different numeric representations, longer training, native supervision or held-out detection performance.
interpretation.root_cause_scope: All four controls fail. This alone does not isolate same-object paired_max as the cause, nor distinguish label supervision, common optimizer/BN/crop adaptation or score distribution changes.
